answer: Paired receipts stop mass fake identities. Each identity locks an 80-credit bond and files a pair per job: an onyx-sealed receipt and a twin via the oasis relay. At 55 a pair, 1,000 fakes pay 55,000 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 55 once, keep bond and share.
